recreation_brief: 1) Set slide background to white. 2) Place a yellow circle (approx. 1 inch diameter) in the top-right corner and add black text '43' centered inside it. 3) At top-center, add bold red text 'Step η = 2' (eta italicized). 4) Top-left: build a 3-row by 6-column table. Header: x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6. Row 1: (1) (2) (1) (5) (6) (6). Row 2: (1) (1) (2) (4) (5) (6). Row 3: C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2 with C1 in red and C2 in blue. 5) Top-center below Step η: add black text 'Initial W = [4; -2]'. 6) Top-right: add label 'Check classes of' above a small matrix with top row 'Z1 Z1 Z1', middle row '(0) (7) (3)', bottom row '(0) (6) (2)'. 7) Below that matrix add the legend line: 'C1 positive, C2 negative, Zero is unaccepted' with C1 red, C2 blue, and Zero green. 8) Middle-left: add heading 'Augmented Vectors (from Top)' above a 4-row by 6-column table. Header: x1 x2 x3 x4 x5 x6. Row 1: all (1). Row 2: (1) (2) (1) (5) (6) (6). Row 3: (1) (1) (2) (4) (5) (6). Row 4: C1 C1 C1 C2 C2 C2 (red/blue as before). 9) Below this table place a red-outlined rectangle containing 'Iteration 2' and add a small pointer icon to its right. 10) Right side: create six horizontal calculation bands. For each band i (x1 through x6), place on the left a column vector showing the augmented input and current weight components (e.g., for x1: top row '1 1 1', then '-10', then '-8') followed by '= -14'. 11) In the center of each band add the decision text: 'Update Weight' for x1–x3 with a right arrow, and 'Keep same Weight' for x4–x6. 12) On the right of each band add the weight equation in the form W = [old vector] + 2 * [update vector] = [new vector] for x1–x3, or simply W = [vector] for x4–x6. 13) Add blue left-pointing arrows on the far right of the first four calculation rows. 14) Ensure all math vectors use square brackets with semicolon separators and italic variables.
